title: Thailand Tourism Guest 360
thesis: On one governed platform, Snowflake turns aggregate daily activity from synthetic loyalty guest cohorts of a fictional Thai hotel group into retention KPIs, 7-day lapse risk per cohort, cancellation rate anomalies and AI answers that cite their sources.

talking_points: 48 loyalty guest cohorts stay in Bangkok, Phuket, Chiang Mai, Pattaya and Krabi; the cards show issue-free stay rate, service issues, lapsed guests and room revenue in THB.
Each KPI is a numerator over a denominator in a curated dynamic table, so you can trace it to cohort-day rows. No individual guest records are stored.
The issue-type chart separates issues that end with guests lapsing from ones that are always resolved, such as the regional booking platform outages in Phuket and Chiang Mai.
tabs.call_out: Guest KPIs you can trace to source rows

transition.line: Which cohorts need a retention review first?

talking_points: A Snowflake ML classifier estimates, per cohort, the chance that guests lapse in the next 7 days.
Precision and recall come from the latest 14 labelled days held out of training, shown next to the base rate.
Anomaly detection picks out unusual cohort cancellation rates, and the forecast covers the next 14 days of service issues for guest relations cover.
tabs.call_out: ML that is evaluated honestly, next to the data

transition.line: Are we keeping in touch with every cohort?

talking_points: CRM touch compliance, profile completeness and pending profile fields show where pre-arrival and post-stay engagement is slipping.
Plotting CRM touch compliance against lapsed guests per cohort shows where the two move together; that is an association, not a cause.
The action memo proposes three prioritised actions using only the KPI, cohort, issue-type and risk rows.

transition.line: What happens when a guest hits a problem right now?

talking_points: New engagement events arrive in RAW.LIVE_ENGAGEMENT, either from the simulator or from Amazon Data Firehose through Snowpipe.
The alert records each ISSUE event with an SOP hint and the risk band of the cohort, then emails the guest relations duty analyst.
tabs.call_out: From a live service issue to a guest recovery case on one platform

talking_points: The Cortex Agent answers metric questions with Cortex Analyst over the semantic view, and procedure questions with Cortex Search over 14 synthetic guest recovery SOPs.
Every answer shows the SQL it generated and the SOP IDs it cited.
tabs.call_out: Answers in plain language that you can check

transition.line: This is how it fits together.

talking_points: One core supports two builds: Snowflake only, or AWS + Snowflake with Data Firehose, Bedrock, QuickSight and Amazon Q.
All data shown is synthetic and aggregate, and rebuilds the same way from the repo.
tabs.call_out: A governed core with an optional AWS edge
